job.prompt:

THIRD IMAGE is approved hand-painted chibi style only, do not copy UI. ONE full-body native-HD square true RGBA transparent frame, not sheet. Girl runs SOUTH TOWARD CAMERA, front view; preserve orange eyes, round girl face, brown-black high bun and flowing long hair, red/gold star crown, black-red-ivory gold-star robe, chains/tassels, star boots. Anatomical RIGHT hand is SCREEN LEFT and grips round star-disk LOWER HANDLE; anatomical LEFT hand SCREEN RIGHT holds exactly THREE star cards. Keep two correct connected arms/hands, two legs, correct shoulder-elbow-wrist chain. Same head size/body proportions/camera and centered framing, bun top about5%, virtual floor94%; no independent crop/scale. Moderate low-bounce jog, bent knees, real landing/compression/push-off, small brief flight; no high-knee march, no huge jump. Shoulder/elbow counter-swing with elbows near ribs, props move with hands; not fixed ceremonial display pose. Knees, ankles and shoes aligned longitudinally TOWARD VIEWER, shoe centers aligned with knees; no toe pointing diagonally outward, no duck feet, no wide splay. Keep feet hip-width or narrower with coherent front/rear occlusion. Preserve rich polished crisp hand painting. No ground, cast shadow, effects, particles, trails, text or watermark.
S01 LEFT FOOT CONTACT. LEFT leg SCREEN RIGHT steps forward TOWARD VIEWER and lands with heel/whole sole ready to bear weight; left knee soft. RIGHT leg SCREEN LEFT trails behind away from camera, heel lifted and knee bent; its boot smaller, higher, partly occluded behind robe. RIGHT disk ARM swings FORWARD toward camera at left lower-chest, elbow visibly bent near ribs; LEFT card arm swings BACK modestly beside right waist, cards lower. Feet tips straight down image toward viewer, not outward.
